title: Spa Franchise Opportunity
name: Balifootspa, 6 Franchisees, Est'd in 2012, Chennai HQ
description: The brand is a Chennai-based wellness and foot spa specializing in authentic Balinese-inspired foot reflexology and therapeutic massage services. With over 15 years of industry experience, the brand has built a reputation for delivering high-quality wellness treatments in a relaxing environment. The outlet serves an average of 20 appointments per day, with an average customer bill value of approximately ₹1,000. The brand is now seeking franchise partners to expand its presence through additional outlets. The business does have a trade license and foot spa license.
